metrics.profile_summary: An aspiring marketing professional and current BBA student with a strong foundation in SEO, social media management, and content creation. Experienced in executing digital campaigns and improving organic visibility across various industries through multiple internships.

experience.description: Managed end-to-end social media operations, content calendars, and performance analytics for Intercontinental Investment Bank and other clients.
Implemented SEO, Meta Ads, and email marketing strategies to improve online visibility and audience engagement.
Utilized SEMrush for keyword research and executed off-page SEO strategies to improve Google search rankings.
Managed digital marketing activities, content creation, and Meta Ads for multiple business profiles in UK and Pakistan.
Developed SEO strategies and managed social media content across Meta, LinkedIn, Threads, Pinterest, and Discord.
Created 1,000+ social media posts via Canva and executed SEO strategies for clothing brands.
Handled property buying/selling processes, client communication, and market analysis in Bahria Town, Karachi.

strengths: Strong proficiency in SEO and social media execution
Experienced with Meta Ads and Canva
weaknesses: Lacks required 5-7 years of professional experience
No people management or team leadership experience
evaluation.summary: The candidate is an entry-level student/intern, whereas the role requires a senior Marketing Manager with significant leadership experience and a proven track record of managing budgets and teams.
